d2_priority.now: the running Bash tool call was aborted (tool_result 'Command was aborted before completion'), message injected right after, a result event emitted, the model then resumed the original task
d2_priority.next: delivered after the current tool call finished, before the next tool call; no separate turn (1 result for the round)
d2_priority.later: delivered after the whole turn ended ('done'), as its own extra turn (2 results)
d2_priority.caveat: Haiku ignored the payload each time (treats peer messages as untrusted), so consumption timing is read from tool-call order and the model's text. For next the injected user line was not in the transcript user lines I parsed; only the model's remark proves delivery.
